full_details: The afternoon was the old play. You were in the house. Nobody at the door gave the part a name, and nobody named a sum. The boxes, if they are worth a sentence, can wait until the book is open. At home the notch stayed shut. Alse did not ask for the knot again. At night you opened the sheets and wrote nothing under the two lines. The feast is Friday.
one_sentence: You were in the old play, and at home the loaf stayed where Monday had measured it.
title: In the old play, and the loaf at home
